method: Derived the first 100 hold-editorial rows from current decision JSONL, then read the matching exact source-inventory example, question and meaning.
Compared current canonical and selected owner titles/meanings and full-source detector matches; treated four raw detector hits as evidence, not automatic alias decisions.
Used prior source-specific independent reviews for repeated/provisional units and the user rule Skip one-time comparisons; record why. No exclusion or owner change is applied.
Retained ordinary potentially reusable collocations on hold when naturalness, sense boundaries or seven-step course value remained unresolved.

strongestActionableLeads.nextAction: Resolve earliest-source ownership for exact same-sense later selected owner4470 without changing stable card/audio IDs; current full-source detector already matches.
Reconcile owner1692 provenance with its nonmatching source frame; test natural created-a-ripple construction before any target expansion.
Compare the fireworks wording with later owner2961 and its existing glitter variant; resolve naturalness and source-order contract before considering an owner migration.
Use complete question context to choose simultaneous versus immediate at once; both owner048 and owner3142 currently match.
Find the source antecedent of it; only then compare stitch-back-together with owner1357 community-fabric restoration.
Check natural comprehension use of topic open up across both exact repeats and test a seven-decision boundary apart from emotional open up to.
Verify natural boundary-setting grammar for draw a line around their time before a standalone seven-step pilot.
Test general run someone’s day/routine control construction, with device versus child agency contrasts, before drafting.
Validate cut away an introduction in prose editing against cut out and ask whether editorial removal supports seven different decisions.
Review four earlier independently flagged extended one-time images for source-specific exclusion; preserve exact source evidence and do not infer rejection of reusable components.

rows.sourceQuestion: What is an example of a time when it is very important for people to arrive on time in your country?

rows.rationale: The group settle their mind mixes a plural group with singular mind; verify the natural possessive/number before extracting settle one’s mind. Owner859 settle down instead concerns settling after movement or agitation.

rows.rationale: One step ahead of the clock may be an ad hoc blend; check idiomaticity and source context before making a target.
